note: The stone clock tower seen from its forecourt: the same tower as on the village square (green arched door, blank plaque, clock face without numerals). Ground floor: entrance hall, seasons, weeks and the first adverbs hall; first floor (stairs up from the adverbs hall): clock room, second adverbs room, 'times of life' room; attic (stairs up again): third adverbs room and the second 'times of life' room. Inside walk: R_time_clock_01 -> R_time_days_01 -> R_time_days_02 -> R_adv_time_01 -> (stairs up) R_time_clock_02 -> R_adv_time_02 -> R_abs_time_01 -> (stairs up) R_adv_time_03 -> R_abs_time_02, and back the same way to the green door.
